subject: Re: Kickoff: Fisher-BRC offline RL baseline track
body:
Ulla — resourcing.

Staffing: Gustavo 50%, Freya 50% from May, Bilal 30%. And Linnea Yamada is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 — the recommendation memo will trigger a follow-on evaluation round against our internal baselines, and July is when that lands, so I've locked her allocation now before Q3 planning eats everyone.

Compute: modest — the D4RL repro runs on single-GPU jobs, and 16 A100s best-effort covers the seed matrix (5 seeds per task, per the paper's protocol). The annoying dependency is Mujoco licensing for the repro environments; procurement says two weeks, so Gustavo starts on the tasks that clear first. Storage: 1TB for logged-interaction snapshots.

If the memo recommends against adoption we release Linnea's July allocation back — but I'm not planning on it.

Ivo
